rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by extending Town Shop fulfillment through Day 30 to capture 2.0x-3.5x premiums on terminal harvest cycles, while synchronizing seed procurement with crop maturation horizons (halting Pumpkins/Strawberries Day 23, Tomatoes Day 25, Carrots Day 27). It shatters the workforce and land deadlock by lowering the hiring buffer to 1.20x and inverting the land acquisition trigger (total_plots < 18 and uncultivated_plots <= 1) while decoupling seed purchasing so plots never sit barren. Finally, it implements cluster harvesting to eliminate transit bottlenecks, caps market orders at 1-2 slots to protect the 10-order engine cap for hands, and removes the phantom 4-unit Wheat reserve for zero-livestock farms.
